conditions: The licensee modifies the Program under this edition.
The modified version supports interaction through a computer network and the users in scope interact with it remotely.
limitations: Section 1 defines Corresponding Source. A particular deployment or collection of components requires its own applicability facts.
Conveying copies and the section 13 combination and inclusion rules each have separate conditions.

statement: When a licensee modifies the Program and the modified version supports remote interaction through a computer network, GNU AGPL version 3 section 13 requires that version to prominently offer every user interacting with it remotely an opportunity to receive the version's Corresponding Source. Access must be available at no charge from a network server through a standard or customary means of facilitating software copying.
